description: Anti-Hero is literally me, the 'it's me, hi, I'm the problem it's me' line has been my entire personality since release 🥹💅🏻 Mother said 'here's my self-loathing, enjoy' and honestly?? we ate it up. The whole 'sexy baby' and 'monster on the hill' bridge is genius and I relate way too hard 😭✨ A little overplayed now but the lyrics still hit every single time, no skips ever.
